newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Bolger says NZ mortgage rates to fall if govt wins.
newsitem.headline: Bolger says NZ mortgage rates to fall if govt wins.

text.p: New Zealand Prime Minister Jim Bolger said on Thursday that home mortgage interest rates would fall within a month if his National Party was returned to power after Saturday's general election.

Bolger has repeatedly warned that a Labour-led government would push interest rates higher. He told a gathering of 160 business people and National party supporters in Rotorua that interest rates would drop within a month if National leads the next government.
"Then you'll start to see the mortgage rate come down, home ownership becomes more affordable.

"That's a kiwi dream, to be able to afford your own home. You can only do that if you have modest interest rates and therefore modest mortgage repayments, all of which is possible," he said. -- Wellington Newsroom (64 4) 4734746
